name: Event Calendar (ByosUI)
summary: Full scheduling calendar with month, week, day, agenda and resource views, drag to move, resize and create, recurrence, time zones and i18n.
useWhen: A bookable or shared calendar with timed events, drag and resize
Locale, RTL or time-zone aware calendars
avoidWhen: Picking a single date, where a date picker is enough
A small month grid with no events
